mods.name: MP ChronoController

mods.name: ISyncYouSyncWeAllSyncForDeSync

mods.name: Faded Origins - Occupations & Traits

mods.name: Vehicles by Faded
mods.description: Vehicles by Faded 1.0.4: headlights shine forward from the lamp glass. Per-vehicle shader zone masks and lights; hoods and trunks open upward, doors swing on a vertical hinge; dark window glass; freezer syncs only on change.

mods.name: Echoes of Humanity
mods.description: 0.17.9 clears NPC hand replication without casting the character to a mixin interface, so the main menu can build its avatar while PZ Optimized classes are installed. Native survivors, local stories, radio, and companion jobs stay in place. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: The Young Died Too
mods.description: 1.1.1 raises the game version cap to 42.21.99. Youth zombies, rare crawlers, and population-neutral conversions. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded's The Hive
mods.description: 2.2.4: ecology accelerator 1.0.3 accepts Project Zomboid 42.21.0, 42.20.4, and 42.20.2. Periodic transition snapshots stay at once per 30 ticks. Population replenishment stays with Deadflow when its authority bridge is present. Existing hunts, population, and artwork are preserved. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Water Expanded
mods.description: The comprehensive Build 42 water, plumbing, irrigation and fuel-network overhaul. One server-authoritative WEX graph connects pumps, valves, meters, seep channels, building-wide liquid plumbing, storage, fixtures, gas stations and generators without a bridge hub. Includes calibrated rain collectors, liquid-effect details, mains reconnection, physical petrol routing, portable pumping, quick view, public physical-container API, optional Faded Java Loader acceleration 1.0.1 for 42.21.0 and 42.20, and a complete standalone native fallback. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Solar Never Faded

mods.name: Temp Control

Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: Faded Locomotion

mods.name: On The Move

mods.description: Server-validated, explicit-opt-in adult intimacy for PZ 42.20. Retains existing player scenes, wardrobe, lifestyle/item integrations and CSR Survivor Bond support.

mods.name: Never Forget: Athena

mods.name: Faded's Hunters Calling
mods.description: A comprehensive Build 42.20.2-42.21.0 hunting system with a responsive three-pane fieldbook, wild boar sounders, game feeders, a hunting tripod, wind-aware scent, a charcoal smokehouse and game cellar, five .308 rifles, four bows, native Crafting and Building tabs, tracking with Java accelerator 2.2.3 and a complete Lua fallback, field dressing, preservation, calls, scents, trapping, and multiplayer-safe administration. mods.description: Version 1.6.3 removes repeated equipped-model rebuilds caused by conflicting M72 and firing-animation callbacks, and restores the AWP bolt after animation expiry. Preserves weapon models, animation timing, balance, settings and the existing Java plugin.

mods.name: Proximity Auto-Read
mods.description: Choose focused literature types or read every nearby unread knowledge item. Separates knowledge magazines from leisure magazines and uses Build 42.20 native read state and timed actions.

mods.name: It's A Trap!
mods.description: Build 42.20.4+. Server-authoritative traps, defenses, explosive barrels, spanning tripwires, cook-off ammo, cages, and reactive hazards. Version 2.1.2 fixes multiplayer world loading by replacing invalid tiledef IDs 8190-8192 with valid, collision-audited IDs 8111-8113.

mods.name: The Path Less Traveled
mods.description: Build 42.20.2 native Skills-tab progression from level 10 to 15 with ClearView-style mastery cells and server-authoritative permanent category buffs.

mods.name: Faded Beds Have Blankets
mods.description: Period-correct removable blankets, larger pillows, sleep warmth, and restful covered-bed sleep for Build 42.20.

mods.name: What A World
mods.description: 1.4.6 adds a server sandbox switch for movement gear sounds, including playback and relay; dark-room fade stays independent. 1.4.5: fixes Java opt-in parsing so explicitly enabled performance features activate. Includes nearby-only gear sounds, 3% acid conversion per actual rain event, and change-only acid exposure sync. Consent-first performance advice for Build 42.20.4, plus an integrated climate suite and a world that behaves like one. What A World observes frame pacing and may suggest Boosted, Standard, Potato, or a vanilla Display-settings review, but never changes display settings, visual quality, UI drawing, texture quality, or a profile automatically. Players review and explicitly accept or dismiss suggestions in the F7 panel. Air temperature depends where you stand. Thunderstorms become authored Black or Dread storms with closing visibility, authored lightning, grid failure and location-aware atmosphere. Acid rain arrives behind a green warning fog and eats clothing, skin and the dead. Twenty-one donor systems are imported and integrated rather than merely governed: visible sky-to-ground lightning synchronised to the engine's own strike, livestock that react to thunder, weather exposure, restorative deep forest, native room occlusion with player-built rooms, cockroach and cicada ambience, a one-per-save aircraft crash that happens hundreds of tiles away and waits to be found, a full ground-cover overhaul, dirt roads kept clear of erosion growth, doors that visibly break in three stages across 61 door families, torchlight that falls through floor openings onto the storey below, flashlights recalibrated from real photometry, a pack that creaks with what you are carrying, working cinema popcorn machines, body bags, a hospital gurney that carries five corpses at once, and pigs, raccoons, rats, mice and chickens that feed on the dead and leave a skeleton with its loot still on it. Every imported system is metered by the same per-player budget table, so a weak machine gets fewer of them rather than a broken world, and every donor defect found on the way in was fixed rather than carried along. Includes server-authoritative weather events and damage, craftable weather stations, battery-powered receivers, recorded station history, and full sandbox tuning. Optional Faded's Java Loader support adds safe load concurrency, exterior occlusion and a pixel framebuffer that powers playable retro consoles, all off until explicitly enabled. The optional What A World - Solar Shadows companion adds projected sunlight and mesh shadows; the tier drives its shadow budget when both are installed.

mods.name: The Big Tree Fix
mods.description: Fixes Build 42.20+ jumbo tree visibility indoors, while driving, and on foot. Registered fade canopies are save-loadable, and default-on infrastructure filtering downsizes selected XL/XXL trees near roads and buildings while preserving giant trees in dense forests. Fade textures based on work by movinow.

mods.name: What A World - Tree Visibility
mods.description: Tree Visibility 1.0.1: confines overrides to tree shaders and restores the native general-sprite shader. Preserves the existing tree visibility effect with simpler transparent-outline output. No texture quality reduction.

mods.name: The Walking Dead: Back to Atlanta
mods.description: Total-theme conversion. Atlanta is the intended world, with TWD clothing, walkers, and Georgia satellite locations including Savannah folded in. Version 1.0.4 completes the Atlanta objects.lua repair: 351 entries were missing table separators, and the repaired file is saved as UTF-8 without a byte-order mark so Kahlua's reloadLuaFile can compile it. Walker visuals from licensed shambler animsets. Deadflow owns population when it is present. Character Creator, Common Sense Reborn, Faded's ClearView UI and Faded Java Loader are used when present and are not required. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: The Walking Dead: Back to Atlanta UI
mods.description: Back to Atlanta UI 1.0.4 keeps the 1.0.3 ClearView colors. The boot card still replaces the stock studio splash. PZ Optimized skips that splash, and the optional Java UI plugin keeps loading instead of failing on the missing splash methods. Loads on Project Zomboid 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus
mods.description: Federated Access & Data Exchange for Dedicated Servers. Version 0.4.11 keeps the periwinkle held-globe title screen and loads the Java bridge on PZ 42.21 and 42.20.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Survivor Pulse
mods.description: Private-by-default offline survivor dashboard for health, wounds, protection, body temperature, moodles, skills, equipment, loadout, encumbrance, nutrition extensions, and manifest-listed Faded mods. Version 1.1.2-nexus.3 skips Java-null ModInfo getters so missing catalog matches no longer spam getName errors. No Nexus connection or broadcast required.

mods.name: F.A.D.E.D Nexus // Nutrition Matrix
mods.description: Offline nutrition matrix for F.A.D.E.D Nexus Survivor Pulse. Tracks calories, carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, weight direction, and strength-training nutrition state without connecting or broadcasting.
